Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices rebounded on Friday, driven by strong gains in heavyweight IT stocks following two sessions of losses. Analysts predict range-bound trading for Monday, with the Nifty facing resistance at 24,200 and support at 23,900 amid mixed global cues.

Markets.title: Former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya seeks SEBI probe into sharp Sensex swing during CAS
Markets.summary: Former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya has asked SEBI to investigate a sharp, sudden swing in the Sensex during the Closing Auction Session on August 27. He questioned whether the new CAS mechanism, introduced on August 3, has vulnerabilities regarding liquidity and price discovery.

Markets.title: Nifty may be in accumulation phase, says Anand James; Ather, Nazara top bets
Markets.summary: Nifty's September series begins with a cautiously positive undertone, supported by options positioning between 24,000 and 24,100. Analysts have identified Ather Energy and Nazara Technologies as top stock picks following recent bullish momentum.

Markets.title: Bullion braces for fresh swings as US jobs data, Iran tensions take centre stage: Analysts
Markets.summary: Gold prices are expected to face increased volatility in September following a recent market decline. Traders are closely monitoring upcoming US non-farm payroll data and escalating tensions with Iran to determine investment strategies.

Markets.title: 10 largecap stocks with up to 40% upside potential. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Analyst consensus estimates from Trendlyne project that several BSE large-cap stocks could deliver strong gains with up to 40% upside potential over the next 12 months. Investors are encouraged to check their portfolios to see if they own any of these high-potential companies.

Markets.title: Nifty mega caps are going nowhere. Why Samco CIO Umesh Mehta put 75% of his Flexicap fund beyond largecaps
Markets.summary: Samco CIO Umesh Mehta has allocated 75% of his Flexicap fund to mid- and small-cap stocks because institutional ownership limits growth in Nifty mega caps. He notes that earnings momentum has shifted away from large caps, while also highlighting investment opportunities in sectors like defence, power, and AI ancillaries.

Geo-Political.title: Iceland votes against restarting talks on joining EU
Geo-Political.summary: Icelandic voters rejected a government proposal to resume negotiations for joining the European Union. According to broadcaster RUV, 52.8% of voters voted against restarting the membership talks.

Geo-Political.title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
Geo-Political.summary: A shooting at a techno event near Zurich killed a 22-year-old woman and injured five other people in their twenties. Police launched a manhunt for the suspect responsible for the attack.

Geo-Political.title: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US
Geo-Political.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a billboard on Canada's Lake Ontario shoreline with the message "Lake Ontario. Now and Always." The installation serves as the latest political jab by Canada against the United States.

Geo-Political.title: WhatsApp chat used to send cash for crime and extremism
Geo-Political.summary: Criminals and extremists used WhatsApp to arrange untraceable cash transfers in the UK and globally. This messaging method allowed offenders to move money for illegal activities without leaving a paper trail.

Geo-Political.title: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
Geo-Political.summary: A strike on a weapons depot near a residential area in Kyiv has left at least 37 people dead and hundreds evacuated. Authorities have launched an investigation into the storage of military weapons near the residential location.

Geo-Political.title: Zambian opposition leader charged with treason
Geo-Political.summary: Zambian opposition leader Brian Mundubile has been charged with treason following a period in hiding at a United Nations facility. The charges against the prominent politician mark a significant escalation in the country's geo-political tensions.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected placement occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top ten artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay ahead of industry changes.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create digital media. The service also allows creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi in Tashkent: India, Uzbekistan seek to unlock next phase of $1.5 billion trade ties
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Tashkent to discuss expanding economic relations between India and Uzbekistan. Both nations currently share $1.5 billion in bilateral trade and aim to double this figure to $3 billion within three years.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council sets date for first meeting since rationalisation last year
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council will hold its 57th meeting on September 12 in New Delhi. This upcoming gathering follows the council's first meeting since last year's tax rationalisation.

Data & Insights.title: India to start preparations for Budget 2027 from 12 October
Data & Insights.summary: India will begin preparations for the Union Budget 2027 starting on 12 October. These pre-budget meetings will be chaired by Finance Secretary (Expenditure) V. Vualnam, according to a government circular.

Data & Insights.title: India forex reserves hit record high on RBI steps to attract US dollars
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves reached a record high following Reserve Bank of India measures to attract US dollars. This increase provides the central bank with greater capacity to support the rupee, which is among Asia's worst-performing currencies.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth narrows to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June due to a dip in mining. Despite this slight moderation, strong performances in the manufacturing and capital goods sectors kept overall growth robust.

Data & Insights.title: Algeria becomes India's 3rd-largest source of LPG in August amid supply crunch
Data & Insights.summary: Algeria exported 110,711 tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to India in August. This made Algeria India's third-largest source for LPG imports during a supply crunch.

India.title: Kerala Excise Bribery Racket Busted, 7 Officers Suspended After Sting Op
India.summary: Kerala authorities suspended seven excise officers following a sting operation that exposed a bribery racket. Excise Commissioner Seeram Sambasiva Rao ordered the suspensions based on directions from Excise Minister M Liju.

India.title: SBI PO Prelims Result 2026 Out: Check Roll Number-Wise PDF, Shortlist Status
India.summary: The State Bank of India announced the results for the 2026 Probationary Officer Preliminary Examination. Candidates can now view their shortlist status and download the roll number-wise PDF from the official website.

India.title: Nepal Flash Flood LIVE Updates: 734 Bodies Recovered, 275 Indians Among Nearly 2,500 Still Missing
India.summary: A glacier collapse caused a massive flash flood in Nepal and Tibet on Wednesday, resulting in widespread destruction. Rescue operations report that 734 bodies have been recovered, with nearly 2,500 people, including 275 Indian nationals, still missing.

India.title: 22-Year-Old Delhi Woman Found Dead In Toilet, Husband, Child Missing
India.summary: Twenty-two-year-old Sabila Khatoon was found dead in the toilet of her Delhi home on Saturday. Her husband and child are currently missing.

India.title: NEET PG 2026 Answer Key Soon; Check Marking Scheme, Tie-Breaking Rules
India.summary: The NEET PG 2026 answer key is expected to be released soon alongside details on the marking scheme and tie-breaking rules. Additionally, a re-examination is scheduled in Jaipur for 2,445 candidates.

India.title: 9 UDP MLAs In Talks With BJP In Meghalaya For Likely Merger: Sources
India.summary: Nine United Democratic Party MLAs in Meghalaya are reportedly in discussions with the BJP regarding a potential merger. This development follows a recent meeting between the UDP legislators and Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

General.title: PC Harper's killers to stay in jail as PM announces changes to early release scheme
General.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced that anyone convicted of manslaughter will be excluded from the early release scheme in the Sentencing Act. As a result, the killers of PC Harper will remain in jail.

General.title: Police release one of two men arrested over fatal house fire
General.summary: Police released one of two men arrested in connection with a fatal house fire that killed a 7-year-old girl and her aunt. Authorities are continuing to question the remaining 23-year-old suspect regarding the incident.

General.title: British woman killed in stabbing at German railway station
General.summary: A 27-year-old German man was arrested after a British woman was killed in a stabbing at a railway station in Rosenheim, Bavaria. Police immediately took the suspect into custody following the incident.

General.title: Church names pastor killed by falling sign at Christian festival
General.summary: Robert Guanco, 41, was a pastor at Jesus the Living Water Church in Eastbourne, East Sussex.

General.title: China censors videos showing deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border
General.summary: Footage of the flash floods have become almost impossible to find on China’s heavily censored internet.

General.title: 97-year-old woman rescued after Nepali floods looked like 'a warrior'
General.summary: Ninety-seven-year-old Guna Maya Bohara survived recent flash floods in Nepal. She was successfully rescued from the disaster using an excavator.
